pages.title: Portable Originium Rig
pages.text: The Portable Originium Rig is the most basic resource collector. No power required — perfect for early game.$(br2)Power: None$(br)Speed: 1 item per 3 seconds$(br)Mines: Originium, Coal, Redstone veins

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: Place the rig on top of a mineral vein block. It starts collecting automatically — output goes into the rig's built-in output slot.$(br2)Manual extraction works, or use an $(l:arknights_endfield:logistics/output_port)Output Port$() with belts for automation.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
